decode: texel (ix, iz) of each map is world x = (ix + 0.5) / res * size - size / 2 (same for z); height = min + step * code; sample bilinear as meta.near.sample in ../meta.json

biome.channels: r forest, g flowers, b meadow; value / 255

noise.channels: rgba = fbm 4 (7 oct), fbm 8 (6), fbm 16 (5), 1 - worley 8/16/32; wraps

trees.rankRule: u16 per tree in trees.bin order; Stillwater draws rank < density * 65536
trees.subset: canonical trees with rank < tier density, in canonical order (WorldData.selectByRank)
trees.layout: planar little-endian: x, y, z u24; s, rot, sx u16; tint rgb u8 interleaved; kind u8
trees.rule: v = (code / q24 - 0.5) * world for x, y, z; s = code / 65535 * sMax; rot = code / 65536 * 2 pi; sx = sxMin + code / 65535; tint = code / 255 * tintMax

colliders.layout: u32 start[grid * grid + 1] (cell = iz * grid + ix, trees of cell c are records start[c] .. start[c + 1]); then 5-byte records: x, z u16le, s u8
colliders.rule: x = code / 16 + origin, z likewise; s = code / 8; blocks within s * 0.03 + walker radius (non-bush canonical trees, every tier)

game.note: src/content/valley.js and the baked anchors; trail is the full trail (Player autoWalk and placeAtStart index it)

poses.note: Replicated in Node from capture.js applyCaptureParams + player.update (not read back from a browser run). Camera y also gets breath = sin(t*1.6)*0.008 m per frame, ignored here.
poses.convention: three.js and Godot are both right-handed, Y up, camera looks down -Z. rotation = (pitch, yaw, roll) applied in YXZ order, which is Godot Camera3D default rotation_order.
